[ISTS.3.2] **For spec tests, `<lowercased_id>` is the spec
section ID** with dots replaced by underscores:

| Spec ID | Identifier slot |
|---|---|
| `IDSP.2.3`  | `idsp_2_3` |
| `IDSP.5.5`  | `idsp_5_5` |
| `IDAT.4.6.2`| `idat_4_6_2` |
| `IARC.1.11` | `iarc_1_11` |
| `IERR.4.1`  | `ierr_4_1` |

Cross-cutting rules (e.g. `IDSP.1.3`, `IDSP.1.4`) take
the same form. Spec areas covered today: IDSP, IDAT,
IERR, IARC.
